<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,500&display=swap');
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');
/* itsrondavis.com — SITE CHROME PORT (nav + footer from the home, 2026-09-20). Source of truth: the home theme 2166393107, block home_css. Ported to /ai-visibility 2026-10-09 by script; do not hand-edit here. */
:root{
  --rh-ground:#f7f5fb; --rh-ink:#16121f; --rh-purple:#330582; --rh-accent:#9a34cd;
  --rh-mut:#5b5566; --rh-line:rgba(22,18,31,0.12); --rh-line-dk:rgba(255,255,255,0.16);
  --rh-grad:linear-gradient(100deg,#330582 0%,#9a34cd 100%);
  --rh-head:'Fraunces','Poppins',Georgia,serif; --rh-body:'Manrope','Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;
  --rh-mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;
}
:root{ --fs-h4:16px; --fs-sm:13px; --fs-nano:10px; --fs-micro:11px; }
.rh-btn{ display:inline-flex !important; align-items:center !important; justify-content:center !important; box-sizing:border-box !important;
  box-shadow:none !important; border-radius:6px !important; font-family:var(--rh-body) !important; font-weight:600 !important;
  font-size:var(--fs-sm) !important; line-height:1 !important; letter-spacing:0 !important; white-space:nowrap !important;
  padding:0 18px !important; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background 140ms ease,color 140ms ease; }
.rh-btn{ background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--rh-purple) !important; color:var(--rh-purple); height:42px !important; }
.rh-btn:hover{ background:var(--rh-purple); color:#fff; }
#section-rhchrome_nav .section, #section-rhchrome_foot .section{ overflow:visible; }
#section-rhchrome_nav .block, #section-rhchrome_foot .block{ padding:0; }
#section-rhchrome_nav a, #section-rhchrome_foot a{ text-decoration:none; }
#section-rhchrome_nav .sizer, #section-rhchrome_foot .sizer{ padding-top:0; padding-bottom:0; }
#section-rhchrome_foot .sizer{ padding-top:28px; padding-bottom:28px; }
#section-rhchrome_foot .sizer .container{ max-width:1202px; }
#section-rhchrome_nav{ position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50; background:rgba(247,245,251,0.88); backdrop-filter:blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--rh-line); }
#section-rhchrome_nav .sizer, #section-rhchrome_nav .container{ padding-top:0 !important; padding-bottom:0 !important; }
.rh-nav{ max-width:1240px; margin:0 auto; padding:14px 28px; box-sizing:border-box; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; height:78px; }
.rh-brand{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; color:var(--rh-ink); flex-shrink:0; }
.rh-dot{ width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:7px; background:var(--rh-grad); flex-shrink:0; }
.rh-stack{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; }
.rh-nm{ font-family:var(--rh-head); font-weight:500; font-size:var(--fs-h4); line-height:1; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:var(--rh-ink); }
.rh-tg{ font-family:var(--rh-mono); font-weight:500; font-size:var(--fs-nano); line-height:1; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--rh-purple); }
.rh-links{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:22px; margin-left:14px; }
.rh-links a{ position:relative; font-size:var(--fs-sm); font-weight:400; color:var(--rh-mut); transition:color 140ms ease; }
.rh-links a:hover{ color:var(--rh-ink); }
.rh-links a.active{ color:var(--rh-ink); }
.rh-links a.active::after{ content:""; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:-6px; height:2px; background:var(--rh-grad); border-radius:1px; }
.rh-nav .rh-btn{ margin-left:auto; }
@media (max-width:900px){ .rh-links{ display:none; } }
@media (max-width:420px){ .rh-nav{ padding:14px 16px; gap:12px; } .rh-tg{ display:none; } .rh-nav .rh-btn{ padding:0 12px !important; } }
#section-rhchrome_foot{ border-top:1px solid var(--rh-line); }
.rh-foot{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; font-size:var(--fs-sm); color:var(--rh-mut); }
.rh-foot nav{ display:flex; gap:18px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.rh-foot nav a{ color:var(--rh-mut); }
.rh-foot nav a:hover{ color:var(--rh-ink); }
body > header.header, #section-header, #section-footer, .footer.footer--section{ display:none !important; }
#section-rhchrome_nav > .section, #section-rhchrome_foot > .section{ padding:0; }
#section-rhchrome_nav .rh-nav{ max-width:1240px; }
#block-rh_css{ display:none; }
#section-rhchrome_nav .nova-block-code, #section-rhchrome_foot .nova-block-code{ padding:0 !important; }
#section-rhchrome_foot .rh-foot{ max-width:1184px; margin:0 auto; }
body nav:not(.rh-links):not(.rh-fnav), body footer:not(.rh-foot){ display:none !important; }
</style>

/* SITE TYPE v2 (2026-09-20) — faces + the 9/13 APP TYPE SCALE. Source of truth: home theme 2166393107, block home_css. Sizes only; this block may only LOWER a measured size. */
:root{
  --fs-display: clamp(30px, 3.2vw, 40px);
  --fs-h1:      clamp(26px, 2.6vw, 32px);
  --fs-h2:      clamp(21px, 2vw, 24px);
  --fs-h3:      18px;
  --fs-h4:      16px;
  --fs-price:   clamp(28px, 2.6vw, 34px);
  --fs-lede:    16px;
  --fs-body:    14px;
  --fs-sm:      13px;
  --fs-xs:      12px;
  --fs-micro:   11px;

  --lh-display: 1.08; --lh-h1: 1.15; --lh-h2: 1.22; --lh-h3: 1.32; --lh-body: 1.6;

body, body p, body li, body td, body input, body textarea, body select, body button, body label{ font-family:var(--rh-body) !important; }
body h1, body h2, body h3, body h4{ font-family:var(--rh-head) !important; font-weight:500 !important; }
body{ font-size:var(--fs-lede); line-height:var(--lh-body); }
body h1{ font-size:var(--fs-display); line-height:var(--lh-display); letter-spacing:var(--tr-display); }

body p, body li, body td, body dd, body dt, body blockquote{ font-size:min(1em, var(--fs-lede)); }
body .form-btn{ font-size:var(--fs-sm); }

body .form-label{ font-size:var(--fs-sm); }
body p[class~="text-sm"], body li[class~="text-sm"], body span[class~="text-sm"], body div[class~="text-sm"]{ font-size:var(--fs-body); }
body p[class~="text-xs"], body li[class~="text-xs"], body span[class~="text-xs"], body div[class~="text-xs"]{ font-size:var(--fs-xs); }
body#encore-theme #form-button, body#nova-theme #form-button{

body#nova-theme .nova-block-cta a{
  border-radius:6px !important; font-size:var(--fs-sm) !important; font-weight:600 !important;
  min-height:44px !important; height:44px !important; padding-left:18px !important; padding-right:18px !important;
}
@media (min-width:768px){
  body#nova-theme main .max-w-7xl{
    max-width:1320px !important; padding-left:30px !important; padding-right:30px !important;
    margin-left:auto !important; margin-right:auto !important;
  }
}
body#nova-theme .nova-block-text p,
body#nova-theme .nova-block-text li,
body#nova-theme .nova-block-text blockquote{ max-width:68ch; }
#block-rh_type{ display:none; }
